clusters.headline: President Trump Signals Preference For Diplomacy In Conflict With Iran
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump stated that military action against Iran remains unlikely provided that ongoing peace negotiations show steady progress.
Experts and analysts are debating the efficacy of a new United States intelligence-led task force designed to monitor borders and weapons flows.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
